Pre-release tags route to test-pypi only; final tags route to pypi; pypi environment reviewers unchanged (static + rehearsal evidence)

description:
New tag-triggered release workflow (.github/workflows/release-v2.yml) that publishes the exact trunk-tested artifacts. No tag-signature requirement (owner decision); safety comes from the controls below. Docs: ADR docs/internal/adr/adr-dev-loop-v2.md (release verification, lines 188-197; G7 release freeze, line 285), artifact contract docs/internal/release-artifacts.md, guide docs/internal/release-guide.md, merge-queue note _project/decisions/merge-queue-retirement-2026-10-03.md. Rebuild from the acceptance list; do not assume any earlier branch survives.

Trigger and overlap (owner decision 2026-10-20, supersedes the 2026-10-17 dispatch-only plan): release-v2 starts on a v* tag push, and by workflow_dispatch with a tag input to re-run a tag. Legacy release.yml is narrowed to workflow_dispatch only in the same PR, because release.yml fails any tag not on origin/release (release.yml:27-35) and both workflows would otherwise fire on every v* tag. The legacy fallback is a legacy release-cut plus gh workflow run release.yml --ref vX.Y.Z.

Version format: PEP 440 (0.5.0rc1, tag v0.5.0rc1). scripts/update_version.py DOC_RELEASE_PATTERN must read the whole rc suffix so release-check passes on rc versions.

Required workflow behavior:
1. Annotated-tag check: refuse lightweight tags (git cat-file -t, and consumer scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py resolve_tag). Legacy tooling (scripts/release_finalize.py) creates lightweight tags, so no legacy tag satisfies this workflow.
2. Admit: run scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py admit for the tag commit (latest exact-commit trunk.yml push run on develop, successful dist-artifact job at trunk.yml:337-390, attempt-bound artifact, hash checks, committed _binaries check). Never rebuild. Never fall back to an older run when the latest is missing, failed, or expired; recovery is a fresh qualifying trunk artifact plus full downstream revalidation.
3. Publish-time tag re-check (mandatory): inside the publishing job, after environment approval, compare both the annotated tag object and its peeled commit against the admission receipt (tag_object, head_sha) with scripts/release_tag_recheck.py. A tag replaced during the approval wait, including a new annotation on the same commit, must refuse publish.
4. Artifact-bound gates: T4 install+smoke on Python 3.11-3.14 x Linux/macOS/Windows (12 cells) installing the admitted wheel. UAT release-gate configs (tests/uat/configs/release-gate-*.yaml) run against the admitted wheel with the checkout package hidden; make uat-gate-check binds the digest of the admitted distributions into UAT evidence and rejects any stage with a skipped, unreachable, pruned, or unexecuted required cell. Also make release-check, ruleset drift (5), t3 blocker gate (6).
5. Ruleset drift gate: scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py without RELEASE_READINESS_OVERRIDE_SHA/_REASON. The tag-ruleset predicate (_project/scripts/ruleset_review_enforcement.py) requires creation, update and deletion rules on refs/tags/v*; the owner adds update and deletion to ruleset v-tag-restricted (18774756) per docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md. dlv2-51 must not hard-depend on release-only existing (decoupling tracked in dlv2-53).
6. t3 blocker gate: block when any open issue carries the release-blocking label (state=open AND label release-blocking), paginate fully, refuse on API error, evaluate before publish. Passes vacuously when no label has been applied; say so in docs.
7. Stage and publish: run scripts/release_admitted_dist.py --stage in the publishing job and publish only staged bytes. Pre-release tags (v0.5.0rc1) publish to test-pypi only and can never queue a pypi deployment; final tags go to pypi (owner approval). Build provenance attestation whose subjects match the staged hashes; acceptance is gh attestation verify naming release-v2.yml as the signer workflow.
8. Owner gate: PyPI/TestPyPI trusted publishers are bound to the workflow file name, so release-v2.yml has no publisher until the owner registers it. The workflow PR states the exact publisher entries needed.

Operating constraints: tag soon after the trunk run (90-day artifact expiry, trunk.yml:390); latest attempt only; no trunk reruns on a tagged commit; ephemeral single-tenant runner per docs/internal/release-artifacts.md threat model. Release workflows are soundness paths: oracle review before merge.
